integrity: The proof is self-contained. The standalone computation is corroborative and is not used as a substitute for the universal inequalities.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one nonsingleton unordered pair-product fiber of size two is assumed.
Multiple collided products and fibers of multiplicity at least three are not classified.
Historical novelty is supported by targeted searches and source comparison, not by an exhaustive bibliography.
title: Sharp \(\Lambda(4)\) constants for a single pair-product collision
